An inspection of the BrandBox AI workspace was completed using read-only tools without running terminal commands or modifying any workspace files. Below is the source map and architectural analysis for the requested areas.

The detailed design document is available in [ui_restoration_plan.md](file:///C:/Users/msicy/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ab3fced6-8289-439d-8089-7384cd1b2436/ui_restoration_plan.md).

### 1. Source Map & Architectural Wiring

```
[ Root Layout (src/app/layout.jsx) ]
  ├── AuthProvider (src/context/AuthContext.jsx)
  └── AppNavigationWrapper (src/components/layout/AppNavigationWrapper.jsx)
        ├── If Public Route -> GlobalNavigation (src/components/GlobalNavigation.jsx)
        └── If Workspace Route -> Renders children directly
              └── Pages wrap themselves in WorkspaceLayout (src/components/navigation/WorkspaceLayout.jsx)
                    ├── Duplicate Top Header (Credits, Notifications, Profile Dropdown)
                    └── Permanent Sidebar (<aside> with 4 navigation groups)
```

---

#### (1) Currently Deployed Dashboard UI
- **Route**: `/dashboard`
- **Page File**: [`src/app/dashboard/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/dashboard/page.jsx)
  - **Component**: `DashboardPage`
  - **Wiring**: Wrapped in `<WorkspaceLayout>`. Consumes `useAuth()` from [`src/context/AuthContext.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/context/AuthContext.jsx) for `user`, `profile`, and `creditBalance`. Fetches projects via `listUserProjects()` and creates projects via `createUserProject()` from [`src/lib/projects/projects-service.ts`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/lib/projects/projects-service.ts).
  - **UI Contents**: User welcome greeting, "+ مشروع جديد" creation modal, 3 metric cards (active projects, available credits, visual assets), quick shortcuts grid (`/chat-ai`, `/images-ai`, `/brand-kit`), and recent projects cards linking to `/projects/${id}`.
- **Alternative / Specialty Dashboard Components**:
  - [`src/components/StableUserDashboard.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/StableUserDashboard.jsx): Standalone dashboard component with tool cards (`/projects/images`, `/projects/video`, `/projects/chat`, `/projects/audio`), project favorites toggle, and generation history.
  - [`src/components/UserDashboardOverview.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/UserDashboardOverview.jsx): Compact workspace overview with live Supabase counts (`projects`, `generations`, `assets`, `profiles.credit_balance`).
  - [`src/components/WorkspaceDashboardShell.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/WorkspaceDashboardShell.jsx): Secondary sidebar layout used by specialty routes (`/dashboard/studio`, `/dashboard/brand`, `/dashboard/marketing`, `/dashboard/print`, `/dashboard/commerce`).

#### (2) WorkspaceLayout / Sidebar / Header
- **Layout File**: [`src/components/navigation/WorkspaceLayout.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/navigation/WorkspaceLayout.jsx)
  - **Component**: `WorkspaceLayout`
  - **Wiring**:
    - **Header**: Sticky bar (`h-16 bg-[#0D0F17] border-b border-[#1F2438]`) with BrandBox logo, admin switcher badge (`SUPER_ADMIN`, `ADMIN`, `SUPPORT`), live credits badge, notifications bell (polls `/api/v1/notifications` every 60s, `PATCH` mark-all-read), and profile avatar dropdown (account settings, pricing, admin, sign out).
    - **Sidebar**: Fixed/desktop `<aside>` (`w-64 bg-[#0D0F17] border-l border-[#1F2438]`) containing 4 link groups:
      1. *منطقة العمل المركزية*: `/dashboard`, `/projects`
      2. *أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي*: `/chat-ai`, `/images-ai`, `/video-ai`, `/audio-ai`
      3. *أدوات الهوية والمحتوى*: `/brand-kit`, `/templates`
      4. *الحساب والاشتراك*: `/pricing`, `/dashboard/account`
- **Navigation Wrapper**: [`src/components/layout/AppNavigationWrapper.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/layout/AppNavigationWrapper.jsx)
  - **Component**: `AppNavigationWrapper`
  - **Wiring**: Checks `WORKSPACE_ROUTES = ['/dashboard', '/projects', '/chat-ai', '/images-ai', '/video-ai', '/audio-ai', '/brand-kit', '/admin']`. When on these routes, it **suppresses** `GlobalNavigation` and relies on `WorkspaceLayout` for header and sidebar navigation.

#### (3) GlobalNavigation
- **File**: [`src/components/GlobalNavigation.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/GlobalNavigation.jsx)
  - **Component**: `GlobalNavigation`
  - **Wiring & Structure**:
    - Top fixed header (`fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[100] border-b border-white/[.07] bg-[#050506] shadow-[0_10px_35px_rgba(0,0,0,.28)] min-h-20`).
    - Logo (`/brandbox-logo.png` linking to `/`).
    - **Center Navigation**:
      - الرئيسية (`/`)
      - لوحة تحكم المستخدم (`/dashboard` or `/auth?next=%2Fdashboard`)
      - أدوات AI Dropdown menu (`WandSparkles` button toggling `/projects/images`, `/projects/video`, `/projects/chat`, `/projects/audio`)
      - Marketing links: القوالب (`/templates`), خطط تسويقية (`/marketing-plans`), الأسعار (`/pricing`), المتجر (`/store`), المطبعة (`/print`), من نحن (`/about`), اتصل بنا (`/contact`).
    - **Left Controls (RTL End)**:
      - Authenticated: Profile dropdown (user name, role badge, avatar, links to `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/account`, `/admin`, and `signOut`), notifications bell with popover & unread counter (`/api/v1/notifications`, polling, `markAllRead`).
      - Unauthenticated: Login & Signup buttons linking to `/auth?next=%2Fdashboard`.
    - **Mobile Drawer**: Hamburger menu with responsive navigation links.

#### (4) AI Images Entry Screen
- **Route**: `/images-ai`
- **Page File**: [`src/app/images-ai/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/images-ai/page.jsx)
  - **Component**: `ImagesAiPage`

Form controls for prompt input, model selector (`openai/gpt-image-2`, `bytedance-seed/seedream-5-0-lite`, `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`), aspect ratio presets, count selector (`1`, `2`, `4`), live API generation `POST /api/v1/generations`, `refreshProfile()` for credits sync, and current session results gallery.

#### (5) Image Projects Gallery & Project Workspace Components / Routes
The codebase contains four distinct structures:
1. **Tool-Specific Image Projects Gallery**:
   - **Route**: `/projects/images`
   - **Page**: [`src/app/projects/images/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/projects/images/page.jsx) -> `<AuthGate><ToolProjectsWorkspace tool="images" /></AuthGate>`
   - **Component**: [`src/components/ToolProjectsWorkspace.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/ToolProjectsWorkspace.jsx)
   - **Features**: Top tool switcher tabs (الصور AI, الفيديو AI, الشات AI, الصوت AI), project search, project creation modal (`createUserProject`), batch delete (`deleteUserProject`), favorite toggle (`setUserProjectFavorite`), generation counts (`/api/v1/project-stats?tool=images`), and opening workspace `/projects/images/workspace?project=${id}`.
2. **Dedicated Image Studio Workspace**:
   - **Route**: `/projects/images/workspace`
   - **Page**: [`src/app/projects/images/workspace/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/projects/images/workspace/page.jsx) -> `<AuthGate><ImageStudioWorkspace /></AuthGate>`
   - **Component**: [`src/components/ImageStudioWorkspace.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/ImageStudioWorkspace.jsx)
   - **Features**: Active project switcher dropdown, generation rail (prompt textarea with random inspiration button, model select dropdown, visual style presets [فوتوغرافي, سينمائي, Minimal, رسمي], aspect ratio presets, resolution buttons [768p, 1024p, 2K, 4K], count buttons [1, 2, 4], Brand Kit toggle, generation cost calculator), live `POST /api/v1/generations` execution, and project asset masonry gallery with download & copy link.
3. **General Projects Library**:
   - **Route**: `/projects`
   - **Page**: [`src/app/projects/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/projects/page.jsx) -> `ProjectsPage` (wrapped in `<WorkspaceLayout>`), listing all projects with industry filter, creation modal, and links to `/projects/${id}`.
4. **Multi-Modal Single Project Workspace**:
   - **Route**: `/projects/[id]`
   - **Page**: [`src/app/projects/[id]/page.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/app/projects/%5Bid%5D/page.jsx) -> `ProjectWorkspacePage` (wrapped in `<WorkspaceLayout>`), multi-modal sidebar rail (Image, Chat, Video) + outputs timeline.
5. **Projects Tool Hub**:
   - **Component**: [`src/components/ProjectsToolHub.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/ProjectsToolHub.jsx), 4-card tool chooser routing to `/projects/images`, `/projects/video`, `/projects/chat`, `/projects/audio`.

#### (6) Legacy Bridge Components & Historical UI Implementations
- **Historical Implementation**: Preserved in [`App.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/App.jsx) (4,969 lines in root workspace). Contains the monolithic single-state React prototype (`App()`, `UserWorkspaceLayout`, `UserDashboardView`, `ProjectWorkspaceView`, `UserImageView`, `UserChatView`, `BrandKitManagerView`, `AdminShellLayout`, etc.).
- **Legacy Bridges**:
  - [`src/components/LegacyWorkspaceStateBridge.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/LegacyWorkspaceStateBridge.jsx): Injected CSS to hide the sidebar (`.workspace-chromeless aside { display: none !important; }`), mounted a floating `ToolDock`, and dispatched fake click events to buttons based on `?view=`.
  - [`src/components/LegacyProjectsRouteBridge.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/LegacyProjectsRouteBridge.jsx): MutationObserver script clicking buttons containing text `المشاريع` / `Projects`.
  - [`src/components/LegacyAdminStateBridge.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/LegacyAdminStateBridge.jsx): Simulated switching to admin views by clicking `لوحة التحكم الإدارية`.
  - [`src/components/RealUserDataBridge.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/RealUserDataBridge.jsx): Injected real Supabase numbers into static text nodes.
  - [`src/components/DashboardRouteFixer.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/DashboardRouteFixer.jsx): Re-routed legacy `/?view=dashboard` clicks to `/dashboard`.
  - [`src/components/UserExperienceEnhancer.jsx`](file:///C:/Users/msicy/BrandBox-UI-Restore/src/components/UserExperienceEnhancer.jsx): Injected click handlers on `svg.lucide-bell` and avatar images.
  - Additional patch files: `AdminWorkspaceReturnFix.jsx`, `AdminRoleRouteGuardEnhancer.jsx`, `AdminNavigationStabilizer.jsx`, `AdminUserManagementEnhancer.jsx`, `ProjectDeleteEnhancer.jsx`, `SidebarPricingEnhancer.jsx`, `PricingRouteIntentEnhancer.jsx`.

*(Note: All these legacy bridges were runtime patches targeting `App.jsx` and are unreferenced by modern Next.js App Router routes).*
